# [TASK] Configure vercel.json and production environment for Vercel deployment

## Task
Create `frontend/filmpire/vercel.json` with SPA routing rewrites and API reverse proxy routing to prevent browser Mixed Content and CORS issues when hosting the frontend on Vercel.

## Scope
Includes `vercel.json` configuration, documentation in `README.md`, and verifying `npm run build` output compatibility.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `vercel.json` defines client-side SPA routing fallback to `index.html`.
- [x] Configures rewrites for `/api/v1/:path*` and `/movie/:path*` to route cleanly to the backend API domain.
- [x] Build succeeds with `npm run build` and produces clean `dist/` output.
- [x] Verified against Vercel deployment requirements.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 2

## Notes
Verified: `frontend/lmdb/vercel.json`.
